mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_send_history ( request_id, source_type, installation_id, plugin_id, instance_id, job_id, execution_id, source_owner_user_id, source_owner_dept_id, channel_owner_user_id, channel_owner_dept_id, channel_id, channel_type, title, severity, content_preview, content_payload, payload_bytes, labels_json, status, max_attempts ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{sourceType}, #{installationId}, #{pluginId}, #{instanceId}, #{jobId}, #{executionId}, #{sourceOwnerUserId}, #{sourceOwnerDepartmentId}, #{channelOwnerUserId}, #{channelOwnerDepartmentId}, #{channelId}, #{channelType}, #{title}, #{severity}, #{contentPreview}, #{contentPayload}, #{payloadBytes}, CAST(#{labelsJson} AS JSON), #{status}, #{maxAttempts} )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_send_history SET status=#{sendingStatus}, locked_by=#{workerId}, locked_at=#{now}, last_attempt_at=#{now}, first_attempt_at=COALESCE(first_attempt_at, #{now}), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{retryWaitingStatus}) AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) AND attempt_count < max_attempts

UPDATE notification_send_history SET status=#{failedStatus}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, next_retry_at=NULL, locked_at=NULL, locked_by=NULL, error_type=#{errorType}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, provider_status_code=#{providerStatusCode}, provider_message=#{providerMessage}, sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE notification_send_history SET status=#{pendingStatus}, attempt_count=0, next_retry_at=#{now}, locked_at=NULL, locked_by=NULL, manual_retry_count=manual_retry_count+1, last_manual_retry_at=#{now}, last_manual_retry_by=#{actor}, sent_at=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{failedStatus} AND content_payload IS NOT NULL
UPDATE notification_send_history SET status=#{skippedStatus}, error_type='SKIPPED', error_message=#{message}, sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT h.* FROM notification_send_history h ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT h.* FROM notification_send_history h h.id=#{id}
SELECT h.* FROM notification_send_history h WHERE h.id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification_send_history WHERE created_at < #{cutoff}
SELECT h.* FROM notification_send_history h h.status=#{failedStatus} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification_send_history WHERE created_at < #{cutoff} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
